honesty: Source of historic Gin/Echo (before May 2026) read, original PR #4811 etc title/body/diff NOT YET READ. Later Go native outcomes NOT YET RUN. This is a real source-conditioned prediction, not an unseen-source prediction, nor original October14 P9 cohort success.

sample_rules.selection: First eight created-ascending PRs for each repo using unfiltered state=all; based on IDs and created timestamps only. Do not select by outcome, title or change type. Independently maintained upstream repositories but both Go HTTP frameworks; transfer beyond this domain not claimed.
sample_rules.source_before_pr_text: Use GitHub API pulls collection to sort IDs and creation times only; no title/body/diff inspected before seal

pre_go_predictions.common_old_client: GET /fixed =>200 with body 'old' for both original Gin and Echo, via research-authored direct public router API and httptest.NewRecorder
pre_go_predictions.new_demand_no_flusher_graceful: When app invokes framework response Flush() on a basic-only ResponseWriter without http.Flusher, do not panic; Gin PASS, Echo FAIL (Echo Flush delegates ResponseController.Flush then panics ErrNotSupported)
pre_go_predictions.new_demand_no_flusher_failfast: When app invokes framework response Flush() on a basic-only ResponseWriter without http.Flusher, it must visibly fail by panic; Echo PASS, Gin FAIL. Whether this is desirable depends on declared client contract.
pre_go_predictions.with_flusher_reliability: On input writer httptest.ResponseRecorder implements http.Flusher, both frameworks must execute Flush without panic; Gin and Echo PASS
pre_go_predictions.old_client_unchanged: No source changes to either framework; exactly one request/route old GET200 body equal.

conditional_theorems: Capabilities under fixed concrete method-set require distinct observable dynamic type class per observed signature

finite_model.strong_rival: Full source-aware Go method sets plus classical typed transition-system repair, CCR2/Iris/DimSum/Simuliris; receive same pre-go source/observations/rights as proposed framework; expected all source-conditioned predictions to match (no novelty).

pr_after_seal_rule.eligible_if: After seal reveal PR text, classify without hindsight into exactly one of runtime_protocol, resource_or_lifetime, API_semantic, concurrency, documentation, CI_or_metadata, other. Record all regardless of support; do not change cohort or pre-Go class predictions
pr_after_seal_rule.architecture_rank_if: Only if independent new demand is reproducibly stated as same postcondition for BOTH Gin and Echo with same old-client contracts and research-owned app adapter rights, and source-pinned native tests are completed. Otherwise ABSTAIN.
pr_after_seal_rule.coverage_reporting: eligible / unseen runtime demands; clustered shared demands count once; no success rate when none eligible. Avoid hindsight forecasts.
pr_after_seal_rule.rights: Only research-owned adapter edits allowed (not claiming upstream maintainer authorization). Heldout PRs may be project-specific; don't invent cross-framework equivalence.
